title: Forbidden Color's
description: A Plugin where when you touch a Forbidden Color you die!
body:
**Have YOU ever wanted to make a Forbidden Color event like your favorete YouTuber?**
With Forbidden Color's you have the availability to do that! This Plugin is perfect for
those who love running fun events!




# Origins of Forbidden Color's
Ever since I saw Skeppy's Don't Touch The Color Video I have wanted to make a plugin just like it for other people to use in their Events. I think it would make Events very fun as this is the first of this kind of Plugin. I will be updating the Plugin as much as I can if you want to help in the Development or suggest features join the Discord!



# Features of the Plugin
Ability to make any color a forbidden one which means anyone who touches the color will be killed! Requires OP for the player to run the commands.


# Commands for the Plugin
/forbiddencolor
Shows available colors

/forbiddencolor (color)
Choose the color that should be forbidden!

/forbiddencolor clear
Clears the current forbidden color
